text.setup: Lap the log, then roll it up your body to rest on your chest, elbows high.
cues: Lean back a touch, dip, and drive the log past your face.
Push your head through at the top.
Lower it back to your chest, then down under control.
mistakes: Pressing with the elbows low and the log in front.
Over-leaning so it turns into a standing incline.
